turns.question: What was the order cancellation rate in August 2026, as cancelled amount divided by total order amount, not the average of daily cancellation rates?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no amount-based cancellation rate (its one cancellation rate is "Share of orders cancelled.", counted in orders, and revenue_eur excludes cancelled orders, so no metric sums cancelled amounts); by that definition the cancellation rate for 1-31 August 2026 was 0.0833 (8.33 % of orders), computed over the whole month rather than averaged from daily rates, with orders_cancelled and orders_total as the closest metrics. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
